items.title: Iran raises stakes with new drone attacks as Trump signals a waiting game
items.brief: Gulf states have been worried for weeks that Iran may again begin to target them in an effort to force a resolution to the nine-month regional conflict on its terms.

items.title: Trump, McDonald’s and Burger King among targets of past X posts that contain redirected website links
items.brief: Some website links included in the X posts of politicians, government agencies and companies were redirected this weekend to unrelated videos, images and websites.

items.title: Estonia to shut its border with Russia, blaming Moscow for foiled arson plot
items.brief: Estonia is to close its border with Russia after blaming Moscow for a suspected attack on a defense technology company, Estonia’s prime minister said Sunday.

items.title: Planes collide at Miami runway crossing a day after national grounding
items.brief: Two planes collided Saturday night on the tarmac at Miami International Airport, just a day after a nationwide flight grounding caused widespread cancellations and travel chaos.
